reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more harsh cuts between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade technique ensures a seamless audio experience. Learn more about this update and how it enhances your gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
